title: Non-Record: Lexis-E: linguistics-driven text compressor (0 model params)
author: shasankp000

data.description: 12-stage linguistics-driven text compression pipeline using morphology, syntax, coreference, phonetic character classes, and arithmetic coding
Morphological root coding with 13 inflection codes to recover surface forms
Coreference-based symbol substitution using f-coref with lossless reversal via stored symbol table
Phonetic character-class encoding with delta encoding over a small alphabet
Context-mixing probability model over character n-gram history, morph code, and POS tag contexts

novel_contributions: Linguistics-driven text compressor with zero model parameters
Morphological root coding with inflection recovery
Context-mixing probability model over char/morph/POS contexts
Custom LEXI binary container with optional zstd post-compression
